infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Run Tracker uses your location to measure distance and speed while you run.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: Allow location Always so your run still counts if the phone locks or you open another app like YouTube.
infoPlist.NSMotionUsageDescription: Run Tracker uses motion data to count your steps.

plugins.locationWhenInUsePermission: Allow Run Tracker to use your location to measure distance and speed.
plugins.locationAlwaysAndWhenInUsePermission: Allow location Always so your run still counts if the phone locks or you open another app.

plugins.motionPermission: Allow Run Tracker to access motion sensors to count steps.
